Limo service in Scottsdale and Phoenix

Scottsdale limo service from Scottsdale Sprinters comes with a professional chauffeur on every booking, in Scottsdale and across Phoenix. Start with who is riding. VIP and ultra-luxury parties lead with the Maybach Jet Sprinter, then the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter and the Luxury SUV (Suburban). Nights out and bachelorettes ride the one-of-one Pink Hummer Limo or a Limo Party Sprinter. Weddings, proms and executive groups take the classic stretch, the Chrysler Limo, or an Executive Sprinter. Every limo here shows its published hourly rate, and you can reach the reservations team at (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

Last updated: September 25, 2026

How much does a limo cost in Scottsdale?

A Scottsdale limo from Scottsdale Sprinters is priced by the hour, from $125 to $295 an hour across the limos on this page, with a 4-hour minimum on every limo here: the vehicle’s published hourly rate times your billable hours, plus 8% Arizona sales tax at checkout, with no per-mile charge, no service fee and no booking fee. Four hours in the Chrysler Limo comes to $600 before tax. Five hours in the Pink Hummer Limo comes to $1,475. Every card on this page prints its vehicle’s own rate from the same grid, so the number you see is the number checkout uses. Longer bookings earn free hours that come off automatically: book 7 to 11 hours and one hour is free, 12 to 14 hours and two are free, 15 hours or more and three are free. A seven-hour night in the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter bills six hours, $1,500 before tax. A one-way ride is priced as a trip instead of by the hour, with no hourly minimum. Gratuity is optional and never added automatically.

Which Scottsdale limo fits your group?

Pick by who is riding: VIP and ultra-luxury parties lead with the Maybach Jet Sprinter, then the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter and the Luxury SUV (Suburban); nights out and bachelorettes ride the Pink Hummer Limo or a Limo Party Sprinter; weddings, proms and executive groups take the Chrysler Limo or an Executive Sprinter. Seats, from the fleet grid: the Pink Hummer Limo seats 18, the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) 16, the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter 15, the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) 13, the Executive White Sprinter and the Executive Black Sprinter 14 each, the Maybach Jet Sprinter 9, the Chrysler Limo and the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter 8 each, and the Luxury SUV (Suburban) 6. The table lists each limo with its seats, hourly rate and minimum. The largest limo here seats 18. For a bigger group we plan two or more vehicles and quote them together; a VIP party larger than the Maybach Jet Sprinter can ride it with the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter or the Luxury SUV (Suburban), one booking each. If your group is on the edge of a vehicle’s seats, tell us and we confirm the fit in writing before payment.

What is the Pink Hummer Limo?

The Pink Hummer Limo is our one-of-one pink stretch Hummer, the bachelorette mobile: 18 guests on handmade custom leather seats behind privacy-tinted windows, with a lit wet bar, a champagne bar, star lighting and a custom sound system, at $295 an hour. It is our most popular ride for women: bachelorettes first, then girls’ birthdays, prom and any night out that celebrates the women in it. Ambient lighting runs outside as well as in, and a partition separates the cabin from the chauffeur. There is one Pink Hummer, so it books by the date. If a pink party bus is what you searched for, the pink party bus guide explains why the pink ride here is a stretch Hummer limousine rather than a bus.

Do you have a classic stretch limo?

Yes: the Chrysler Limo is our classic stretch limousine, black outside with ambient lighting and privacy tint, up to 8 guests on classic leather seats, with a wet bar, a custom sound system and seventeen colour settings for the cabin lights, at $150 an hour. It is the one for prom, anniversaries, date nights, concerts and the wedding exit: the long silhouette everybody turns to look at. A stretch limo is a sedan lengthened for a lounge cabin; the Pink Hummer is the same idea built on a Hummer, which is why it seats a bigger group.

What is a Limo Party Sprinter?

A Limo Party Sprinter puts limo-style seating, a wet bar and party lighting in a Mercedes Sprinter: the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) seats 13 under fiber-optic roof lights, the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) is our largest Sprinter with a star-roof ceiling for 16, and the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter is the top of the line. The Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter adds fiber-optic lighting with eighteen modes, laser lights, a fog machine, automatic doors and an intercom to your chauffeur, for up to 15. It is also ultra-luxury, so it rides with the VIP group on this page. The Limo Party Sprinters ride with the nights-out group, never with a corporate or family booking. For executive groups and weddings that want the room without the party lighting, the Executive Sprinters carry reclining leather seats and space for bags.

Where do Scottsdale limos pick up?

Anywhere in Scottsdale and the greater Phoenix area: your hotel, home, restaurant or venue, with every stop on an hourly booking included; in Old Town’s entertainment district, from 5 p.m. to 4 a.m. every night, hired vehicles load and unload only in the marked Passenger Convenience Areas. Old Town Scottsdale is where nights out start: dinner, the bars and the clubs, in the Pink Hummer Limo or a Limo Party Sprinter. The City’s Transportation Safety Zone covers the entertainment district every night from 5 p.m. to 4 a.m.: through lanes stay clear, and hired vehicles stop only to load or unload at the marked Passenger Convenience Areas, so your chauffeur meets the group where the City allows a limo to load. North Scottsdale books weddings at the resorts and desert venues along the 101, and dinners around Kierland and Scottsdale Quarter; the Chrysler Limo and the Executive White Sprinter are the wedding picks. Central Scottsdale, Gainey Ranch and McCormick Ranch book anniversary dinners and small-group evenings in the Luxury SUV (Suburban) or the Maybach Jet Sprinter. Paradise Valley estate events stage the vehicle at the property. Stops on an hourly booking are complimentary, because you have already bought the time. On a one-way ride or a round trip, an added stop carries a fee shown on the quote.

Do you offer limo service in Phoenix?

Yes: we run chauffeured limos throughout Phoenix and the Valley, from the Biltmore to downtown Phoenix, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert and Glendale, with the same vehicles, rates and chauffeurs as in Scottsdale. The drive is part of the hours you book, and your chauffeur plans the route around the Valley’s freeway traffic, so a Phoenix dinner and a Scottsdale nightcap can share one booking. On summer evenings the cabin is cooled before the group boards. For a Phoenix wedding, a Tempe or ASU celebration, or a concert downtown, pick the group above and the limos that fit it appear with their rates.

Can you pick us up at Phoenix Sky Harbor in a limo?

Yes. Scottsdale Sprinters holds the Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX) ground transportation permit. We also pick up at Scottsdale Airport and Phoenix-Mesa Gateway, and your chauffeur tracks your flight. Airport rides are priced as a one-way trip with no hourly minimum. The airport transportation page has the full detail, from greeters to luggage.

Can you drink in a limo in Arizona?

Passengers 21 and over may bring their own alcohol, and we do not sell it; if anyone under 21 rides, no alcohol comes on that trip, which makes every prom ride alcohol-free, and there is no smoking, vaping or food inside any vehicle. Arizona’s vehicle-for-hire open-container policy, A.R.S. § 4-251, is what allows adults to drink on board; the alcohol-laws guide covers the law itself. Anyone under 21 stays on soft drinks, and the chauffeur never drinks. Prom rides follow a written zero-alcohol passenger policy, and a guardian contact can get pickup and drop-off updates; the prom night page has the full plan, from the photo stop to the ride home.

Frequently asked questions

How much does it cost to rent a limo in Scottsdale?

A limo is priced by the hour: the vehicle’s published hourly rate times your billable hours, from $125 to $295 an hour across the limos on this page. There is no per-mile charge, no service fee and no booking fee. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout, and gratuity is optional. Pick the limo above and the price is on the page.

How much is a limo for 2 hours, 4 hours or a whole night?

An hourly booking has a 4-hour minimum on every limo here, so a two-hour ride books the minimum; a one-way ride is priced as a trip instead, with no hourly minimum. Bookings of 7 hours or more earn free hours that come off automatically, so a seven-hour night bills six.

How many people fit in a limo?

It depends on the limo: the Pink Hummer Limo seats 18, the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) seats 16, the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter seats 15, the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) seats 13 and the Chrysler Limo seats 8. If your group is on the edge, tell us and we confirm the fit in writing.

Can you drink in a limo?

If everyone drinking is 21 or over, yes: bring your own, because we do not sell alcohol. Nobody under 21 drinks, and if anyone under 21 rides, no alcohol comes on that trip. There is no smoking, vaping or food inside the vehicle.

How much do you tip a limo driver?

Gratuity is optional, is never added automatically, and goes 100% to your chauffeur. Add it at checkout or hand it over in person.

Can we book a limo for prom?

Yes. Prom rides follow a written zero-alcohol passenger policy, and a guardian contact can get pickup and drop-off updates. The Chrysler Limo is the classic prom stretch; the Executive White Sprinter carries a bigger group.

What is the difference between a limo, a stretch limo and a limo Sprinter?

The Chrysler Limo is the classic stretch: the long black silhouette, up to 8 guests. The Pink Hummer Limo is a stretch Hummer that seats a bigger group. Our Limo Party Sprinters put limo-style seating, a wet bar and party lighting in a Mercedes Sprinter.

Is Scottsdale Sprinters a reputable limo company?

Every chauffeur is background and MVR checked, drug screened and trained, and the company is licensed and insured with commercial coverage on every vehicle. Guests give us a 5.0-star Google rating across 511 reviews.

Do you pick up at Phoenix Sky Harbor?

Yes: Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX), Scottsdale Airport (SCF) and Phoenix-Mesa Gateway (AZA). Scottsdale Sprinters holds the Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX) ground transportation permit. Your chauffeur tracks your flight.

How far in advance should I book a limo?

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open.

Do you serve Phoenix?

Yes. We run chauffeured limos throughout Scottsdale, Paradise Valley and the greater Phoenix area.

Can we decorate the limo or add a Just Married sign?

Yes, as priced add-ons you choose at checkout: Just Married signage, balloons and décor, a red carpet arrival and more. Anything vehicle-specific is confirmed in writing before payment.
